nuggets.text: DeLane Fitzgerald is the first head coach in Thunderbirds history to reach 100 career wins.
Thunderbirds coach DeLane Fitzgerald was a fullback on James Madison's 1999 Atlantic 10 championship team.
Floyd Chalk ran for 183 yards and three touchdowns in the Thunderbirds' 47-42 Beehive Bowl win over Weber State.
Thunderbirds QB Will Burns ran for 148 yards against Weber State, including a 75-yard touchdown.
The Thunderbirds' Beehive Bowl win over Weber State was a nonconference game, even though both are Big Sky members.
The Thunderbirds piled up 510 yards and held the ball for 43:34 at No. 2 Montana in their opener.
Thunderbirds safety Parker Vance picked off No. 2 Montana on the Grizzlies' first offensive play.
The Thunderbirds' football mascot is an extra-powerful Thunderbird inspired by Thor, the Norse god.
The Thunderbirds' home, Eccles Coliseum in Cedar City, sits 5,800 feet above sea level.
Thunderbirds coach DeLane Fitzgerald is the winningest coach in Frostburg State history.
